bannerText: Muse X Poster: bài đã điền sẵn (đã bỏ tag Binance). Bấm Post trên X để đăng, rồi báo Muse là xong.
note: Muse X Poster v1.8: POKE THE RESUMED EXTENSION TO POLL NOW (user 2026-11-16 ~13:48). Re-enabling the Orbit extension alone does not resume its polling (its onStartup does not run on enable and its alarm was cleared on disable), so the user had to press its Poll now button by hand. v1.8: after every resume (job outcome, watchdog, manual Resume button, install/startup), the X extension sends ORBIT_POLL_NOW to the resumed extension id via chrome.runtime.sendMessage, with one retry after 3s; the Orbit poster v2.17+ accepts it via onMessageExternal. If the id is not Orbit the message is ignored and the failure is swallowed. v1.7 watchdog + postClicked milestone are unchanged.
